armed_gun_idle.note: idle with attitude (design gate 1, item 9). WHO: a vain king posing with his heirloom gun for a portrait nobody is painting. HOW: weight on one leg and a slow shift to the other (a dip in the middle), the cape and the crown arrive a frame late, chin up and smug in the two held poses; between them he tips the gun to admire the brass. The gun is at port arms (aim 40), tipped to 30 while he admires it; both hands on it in every frame (hand = grip, hand2 = the gun's own pump point of that angle row). 288 ticks = 4.8 s, two turns of the gun's own 2.4 s idle. Frames 0 and 9 are the held poses.

knockout.note: Host art 12.11, gate 3 redraw (N2; never a body): the hit, he sits down hard and slumps (one leg flat with its sole to us, the other knee up, cape pooled), the crown pops off, spins and lands on the floor beside him (frames 1-3), then the dizzy loop from frame 4: dizzy-smug face (eyes unfocused, a heavy lid, the smirk sliding), he sways, the crown rocks on the floor, two tiny microphones and a tiny newspaper circle his bare head (never stars). 72 ticks = the 26-tick intro + 46 ticks of the loop. NO weapon in any frame (weapon null: the dropped gun carried the star mark beside a knocked-out hero).

knockout_loop.note: the knock-out's dizzy loop on its own (= knockout frames 4-11); no weapon

pose.note: STANDARD SCREEN STATE (ONE MODEL A CHARACTER, 12.11): pose, the king waves to his crowd, smug (his wave_off 0-3 and back). Game size, a loop.
